The Superior Challenger's Cache is a chest that spawns at the end of a Mythic+ run if it was completed 20-39% faster than the timer, in addition to the regular Challenger's Cache. It contains a random item from that dungeon, scaled up to the item level of the Mythic Keystone (item) used for the run. Vanity items such as mounts and toys that drop in the dungeon can also drop from the Challenger's Cache. Completing a dungeon faster at 40% or higher than the timer will have a third chest, Peerless Challenger's Cache, available for additional loot.

Sunwalker Nadura is a tauren located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. She was not content to be a laborer, as she had not walked the path of the Sun to haul rubble and rebuild structures. Nadura appears at the celebration camp in Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris during the Midsummer Fire Festival. She can be seen speaking with Sunwalker Malu.

Sunwalker Malu is a tauren located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. He learned much from Sunwalker Dezco and was content to be a laborer. As such, he aided in clearing rubble and rebuilding structures. Malu appears at the celebration camp in Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris during the Midsummer Fire Festival. The Sureki are a faction of Kaheti nerubians named after their late leader, Queen Ansurek, who carry out her will in Azj-Kahet. Their actions include the abductions of civilians, leading assaults on Hallowfall and the use of shadecasters and criers to spread propaganda. The Sureki were also responsible for harvesting the Black Blood in Ajz-Kahet for the purpose of creating ascended nerubians.

Surviving Warlocks are located on the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn after the fall of Dalaran. They stand around a Soulwell, with some of them, handing out healthstones to the wounded. Ritssyn Flamescowl's body is impaled on the spikes of a portal nearby, while Rittsyn's Soulstone is located just below.
Swabbie's Cap is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 80 Trader's Tender.
Suspicious Supplies are provided by Xirath for Soul of Mischief (quest). Placing them at the nearby Skull Piles will spawn Manathirst Imps.
Swarm-Maven Donmiss is an ascended nerubian found in the Burrows in Azj-Kahet.
Swarming Cogwalkers are cogwalkers located in the Ringing Deeps.
The Swaying Span is the remaining half of the Grand Rampart found in the Nerub-ar Palace, where Rasha'nan can be fought.
Swarmbots are cogwalkers located in the Ritual Hall in the Hall of Awakening during Gearing Up for Trouble.
Swabbie's Shovel is a cosmetic one-hand weapon that can be purchased at the Plunderstore for 1,000 Plunder.
Swabbie's Oar is a cosmetic two-hand mace that can be purchased at the Plunderstore for 1,000 Plunder.

Survivor's Guilt begins the Fate of the Kirin Tor storyline, unlocked the week of 7 January 2025 during the Siren Isle campaign. This storyline awards the Fate of the Kirin Tor achievement. Find Khadgar in the Foundation Hall of Dornogal to begin.
